scripts.build: rm -rf dist && python3 scripts/generate-fonts.py && node scripts/generate-meta.mjs && tailwindcss -i ./src/index.css -o ./dist/assets/css/index.css --minify && eleventy && terser dist/assets/js/main.js -c -m -o dist/assets/js/main.js
scripts.dev: npm run generate-fonts && npm run generate-meta && (npm run dev:css & npm run dev:11ty)
